title: MoRAE: Flow-Friendly Self-Supervised Latents for Text-to-Motion Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.29180v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Which latent space should a text-to-motion generator model? We show that a self-supervised motion representation, once compressed, is a better generative space than latents learned by reconstruction. Our approach, MoRAE, is simple: we pre-train a Motion-JEPA encoder that predicts hidden joint trajectories from the rest of the body, and compress its frozen features into a compact latent for a standard flow transformer. Two observations drive this design. First, prediction yields features that capture action semantics and cross-joint structure better than reconstruction. Second, these features are ill-conditioned, and a standard flow transformer generates poorly in them directly. Compressing them into a compact latent makes generation reliable and places cross-joint structure on the directions the flow models most accurately. translated_title: MoRAE：面向文本到动作生成的流模型友好型自监督潜空间表示
translated_abstract: 文本到动作生成器应该建模哪种潜空间？我们证明，自监督运动表示经过压缩后，比通过重建学习得到的潜空间是更好的生成空间。我们的方法MoRAE很简单：我们预训练一个Motion-JEPA编码器，从身体其余部分预测被隐藏的关节轨迹，并将其冻结的特征压缩为紧凑潜变量，供标准的流变换器使用。两个观察结果推动了这一设计。首先，预测产生的特征比重建更好地捕捉动作语义和跨关节结构。其次，这些特征是病态的（ill-conditioned），标准流变换器直接在其中生成效果很差。将其压缩为紧凑潜空间使生成变得可靠，并将跨关节结构放置在流模型最准确建模的方向上。凭借58M参数的DiT和标准CLIP文本条件，MoRAE在HumanML3D上实现了最先进的FID。
tldr: MoRAE通过Motion-JEPA预测式自监督预训练获取运动特征，并将其压缩为紧凑潜空间供流变换器可靠生成，从而在文本到动作生成任务上取得最先进的FID性能。
en_tdlr: MoRAE compresses prediction-based self-supervised motion features from a Motion-JEPA encoder into a compact latent space for reliable flow-transformer generation, achieving state-of-the-art FID on text-to-motion generation.
